name: Hibernal-Gnomon
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by towering mountain ranges, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Instruments disagree about the signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever controls dark crystals controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
